quizzes.question_text: Emma had a ribbon that was 6.5 metres long. Then Emma cut off 4.7 metres. How long is the ribbon now in metres?
solution: Length of ribbon now = Starting length - Length cut off. Subtract 6.5 - 4.7.
The ribbon is 1.8 metres long now.

The rope is 7.7 metres long now.
